description: Predict differentiated thyroid cancer recurrence from demographic and clinical attributes. Binary target Recurred_binary is encoded as 0 = No and 1 = Yes. Profile: 383 rows, 16 features, 15 categorical clinical fields plus Age, no observed missing values, moderately imbalanced target (275 No / 108 Yes).

plan_checklist.description: Plan includes inspecting schema, feature types, target distribution, and basic data quality before modeling.
Plan includes checking and handling missing values if present.
Plan includes identifying and encoding categorical or string features.
Plan includes checking class balance and using an imbalance-aware validation/modeling strategy when needed.
Plan uses the task metric and an appropriate validation split or cross-validation.
Plan chooses model families suitable for the dataset size and tabular feature mix.

metadata.bench_preprocessing: Encoded Recurred as Recurred_binary and removed the original string target column.
metadata.drop_columns_rationale: Response is excluded at manifest level because it is a post-treatment/response field and is a near-direct proxy for recurrence.
